title: ATS Announces CEO Departure
summary: ATS Corporation (TSX: ATS) (NYSE: ATS) (“ ATS ” or the “ Company ”) today announced that Andrew Hider will be stepping down from his role as Chief Executive Officer of the Company and from its Board of Directors (the “ Board ”) to pursue a new leadership opportunity outside the automation industry. The effective date for Mr. Hider’s departure from the Company is expected to be by the end of August on a date to be determined by the Board. As a result of the foregoing, Mr. Hider will be withdrawing his candidacy for election to the Board at the Company’s upcoming Annual General Meeting (“ AGM ”) being held on August 7 th , 2025. The Company will be filing an amendment to its management information circular dated June 18 th , 2025 (the “ Circular ”) and form of proxy to reflect this change.
